subtitle_or_header: Vector of Dimension "2" to define Position

bullets: This vector can be used to define word position at step "t" , t=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,....
Distance between vectors representing positions "t" and "t+1"  is constant irrespective of "t"  [Distance (Pos1, Pos2) = Distance (Pos90, Pos91)]
"t" may take any positive value (No limitation of length of Sequence )
Position Vector Length = 2  (Cannot be combined with Word Embedding Vector) ??
labels: 32 (slide number inside yellow circle, top-right corner)
Where "t" is the step (position) and ω is the frequency of trigonometric function Sine/Cosine
equations: [ sin(ωt) ; cos(ωt) ]  (2-component column vector with large square brackets)
